title: Lifelog: The Operator's Manual
author: Field notes for Harsh Kasana
description: How the log that keeps every other system honest actually works and how to run it — the append-only stream in ~/.lifelog, why a cursor beats a timestamp, what only you can capture and what records itself, how decay stops skills.md from lying about you, and the sync loop that turns fourteen months of commits into a profile you didn't have to remember.
